Counterpoint Research publishes a new report showing that Apple, Garmin and Huawei grew against the overall decline in the smartwatch market in the second quarter of 2026, with Huawei reaching a record-high share of global shipments. The details are as follows.

Apple records growth across all regions

Counterpoint Research yesterday released a new report indicating that global smartwatch shipments in the second quarter of 2026 fell 4% year-on-year.

The report noted that Apple recorded the largest increase, with shipments growing 14% year-on-year, accounting for 20.1% of global smartwatch shipments and maintaining its second-place position behind Huawei. Huawei's shipments grew 1% year-on-year, with a market share of 21.8%.

Ranking next is Imoo, with a market share of 7.8% but shipments falling 3% year-on-year; closely followed by Xiaomi at 6.1%, with shipments plunging 38%. Garmin holds a market share of 5.6%, with shipments growing 11%. The remaining brands together account for the remaining 38.5%, with shipments falling 8% year-on-year.

The report also mentioned that Apple was the fastest-growing among the top five brands in China that quarter, 'showing a recovery after the decline in the same quarter of 2025,' and noted that China's consumer electronics subsidy programme also helped drive smartwatch sales.
